title: dep-scan config show output
description: The document `depscan config show --format json` writes on stdout: every effective scan option with the value the next scan receives and where the value came from. Values are printed verbatim, so a path-valued option shows the form the scan will read it in, not a rewritten one. Precedence when several sources set one option: the command line, then the checks or profile, then the depscan.toml file, then an environment variable, then the default.

options.description: One entry per internal option, named by its dest in the parsed namespace.

value.description: The value the next scan receives, verbatim.

source.description: Where the value came from, the highest-precedence source that set it.
